ask: Which USB option should we build: personal backup, hand-over between people, or nothing yet?
problem: Translators work offline for weeks. Unsent recordings live only on the phone, so a lost phone loses that work.
found: The server accepts each event once and checks its author, so an imported event is safe if it enters as unsent. The app cannot save files today. I found no trace of LAN-227's export in the repository.
changed: Nothing in the app yet. This pull request holds only the question and three pictures.
why: Nothing keeps today's rules but risks lost work. A personal backup is the smallest fix. A hand-over helps offline teams but needs a new permission rule. I recommend the backup.
touches: Options 2 and 3 add a file picker, which changes the Play Store file answers and needs a decision-log entry.

options.label: Build nothing yet
options.result: Nothing changes. A lost phone still loses unsent work.

options.label: Personal backup and restore
options.result: A person saves unsent work to a USB stick and restores it on a new phone. The server checks it as usual.

options.label: Hand-over between people
options.result: A courier carries work to an online phone, which sends it. Needs a new permission rule and more testing.
